40/G.goal: Explain the navigation and system-control design space for XR systems, covering locomotion techniques, wayfinding supports, and multimodal interaction options.
40/G.achieves: This lets the learner design or evaluate the movement, orientation, and control features of the course's XR case study.

40/O1.goal: Describe how navigation in an immersive experience is organized into travel and wayfinding, with the travel side expressed through distinct locomotion technique families.
40/O1.achieves: This gives the learner a basis for choosing movement methods when designing the navigation part of an XR system.

40/O2.goal: Describe how wayfinding supports help users form spatial knowledge and mental maps for moving toward destinations in a virtual environment.
40/O2.achieves: This lets the learner specify orientation and destination-finding aids when designing an immersive environment.

40/O3.goal: Describe interaction techniques for controlling system state and modes in an XR system, including multimodal command methods.
40/O3.achieves: This lets the learner define controls and commands for the XR application as part of system design.
